name: Amano Shiori
source:
Manager and the only lecturer at "Shooting Star Garden". Although graduated as the top of class from a famous university and took up employment as a teacher, retired after just six months. 

A bad adult who likes cigarettes, drinking alcohol and gambling.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050507113222/http://210.166.209.38:80/html/soft/flove/chara_e.htm]website[/url]]
